title: AI Beat Human Writers in a 2500-Reader Study
description:
Cambridge asked 2500 readers to judge stories: ChatGPT-4 vs top literary magazines 🔥

AI won on quality (1.5 vs 0.97) and immersion. Readers guessed the author about as well as a coin flip 😅

Then researchers revealed which was wich, and scores on the exact same texts dropped. So the bias sits in the label not the writing ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
